text: SOLUTION (a) The function is continuous for z > 1, since 2 + cos(rz) is continuous and 27 is continuous, and dividing one continuous function by another gives a continuous function as long as the denominator is not 0. (b) The function is always positive for > 1, since 2 + cos(mz) is positive when 27 is positive, so the quotient is positive. (c) The function is not decreasing for # > 1: f(1) = 1/2 < f(2) = 3/4. (d) On > 1 the function is not decreasing, so the integral test does not apply.
